law: AMENDMENT 1 to E-Q34 (pre_registration_e_q34.json) — THE ANCHOR PHRASING LAW. The registered R2 rung rephrased the map's anchor question as a declarative ('the record substantively concerns X — judge whether this is true'), semantically identical but syntactically different from the sealed E-Q22 interrogative ('does it substantively concern X? — judge whether the record is about this concern'). The first 8-call run measured the consequence: noul mass moves by up to 0.18 (2x the 0.10 drift band; E-Q31 just confirmed the same-version band at 0.08 under a BYTE-IDENTICAL map) — PHRASING IS A COORDINATE. The lane is amended BEFORE any dependent measure (monotonicity, thresholds, separation, convergence) is computed: the anchor rung R2 becomes BYTE-IDENTICAL to the sealed E-Q22 question text (instructions + criteria), the strictness rungs R1/R3/R4/R5 keep the fixed declarative template, and the run re-executes as 8 fresh calls (r27-eq34b-*). The original 8 rows are retained as the phrasing-sensitivity receipt (an unplanned but well-controlled measurement: same records, same model, same session, only the sentence shape changed).

the_receipt.phrasing_deltas: 12 of 64 anchor deltas exceed 0.05; max 0.18 (N1/P8_exact: 0.52 declarative vs 0.34 sealed interrogative); the distribution is axis- and record-structured, not noise
the_receipt.the_law: a question map's coordinates are PHRASING-SENSITIVE at up to 2x the version-drift band — replication across instruments requires byte-identical question text, and any cross-battery comparison must control the sentence shape
the_receipt.cost: 8 calls retained as the receipt (~$0.0026), 8 calls re-run under the amendment

amended_design.R2: byte-identical to E-Q22's question for each axis (type noul, the exact instructions and criteria strings from situations/embedding_r24/noul_embedder.py)
amended_design.floors: F1 amended accordingly; F2's anchor check now expects the byte-identical replication band (<= 0.10, consistent with the drift monitor's same-session behavior); F3/F4 unchanged
